'''0U-1FY''' was an associate of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] who designed a remote access point to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Data Entry" />

==Behind the scenes==
0U-1FY was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in a description of the item "Data Entry," which players could use to recover their health points. 0U-1FY is a direct reference to a member of the game's community, [https://web.archive.org/web/20221123105207/http://dulfy.net Dulfy], who runs a fan site and guide.<ref name="Data Entry" />
